newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo stocks end flat on high turnover.
newsitem.headline: Colombo stocks end flat on high turnover.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed steady on Tuesday in trade led by finance, plantation, food and beverage and manufacturing stocks, brokers said.

The all share index closed 0.14 points lower at 633.28. Price declines led gains by 21 to 19. Highly capitalised Development Finance Corporation of Ceylon Ltd fell 2.75 rupees to 255.25, Hayleys Ltd three to 197.
Turnover was 86.3 million rupees on 2.7 million shares, led by 2.3 million Kotagala Plantations, 79,100 DFCC, 32,000 Haycarb and 43,200 Lion Brewery.
"Local buying of the parcel of Kotagala Plantations at 23 rupees a share boosted turnover," said Thikshan Arulampalam, a trader at Lanka Securities.
The buyer was convinced that plantation shares would rise further due to buoyant tea prices, he said.
The index was flat as investors were sitting on the sidelines ahead of Friday's local government election, brokers said.
